literal: Among those learned in treatises, becoming an expert in treatises, and among those with spears, delivering a mission of victory, is the quality of an envoy.
translation: To be an expert among those learned in books, and to deliver a mission of victory among spear-bearing kings, is the true quality of an envoy.
modern: நூல்களைக் கற்றவர்களுள் நூல் அறிவு மிக்கவனாக விளங்குவதும், வேல் ஏந்திய அரசர்களுள் சென்று தன் அரசனுக்கு வெற்றியைத் தரும் தூதுச் செய்தியைச் சொல்வதும் ஒரு தூதனின் தகுதியாகும்.
explanation: This couplet outlines the essential qualities of a successful diplomat or envoy. First, the envoy must be highly learned, standing out as an expert even when surrounded by other scholars of political and ethical treatises. Second, when standing before spear-bearing kings who hold military power, the envoy must possess the eloquence to deliver their mission in a way that secures victory. Thus, intellectual supremacy and persuasive speech under pressure are the defining traits of an envoy.
